hooks.name: Record Development Memory
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, record a short memory entry only if something worth remembering happened.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Decide whether anything from this task belongs in project memory, following .kiro/steering/memory.md. Record only if one of these is true: a decision was made, a milestone in tasks.md was reached, a non-obvious gotcha was found and fixed, a spec/steering/contract changed, an approach failed twice, or work is being handed off unfinished. If none apply, do nothing and say nothing. If one applies: (1) append a single 2-5 line entry to .kiro/memory/dev-log.md in the documented format (date, type, short title, what, why, follow-up); never edit earlier entries. (2) If the fact matters for future sessions, update .kiro/memory/MEMORY.md by replacing stale lines, keeping it under about 80 lines. Never write secrets, API keys, access codes, .env values, cookies or personal data; refer to variables by name only. Do not commit or push. Do not change any other file.
